response.original_title: Nothingscapes and the Inherent Politics of Texture
response.overview: A 4-Channel work intended for installation and theatrical screening. Presented here in its silent version. The work is also presented with a live soundtrack performed by M. Woods and a recorded version is also available. This work is also intended to be looped on four walls in a room with either recorded or live sound. A piece of the DAILIES FROM DUMPLAND installation - Part 1 of THE NUMB SPIRAL.
